description: Fetch aggregated federal obligation amounts grouped by fiscal year, fiscal quarter, or fiscal month. All grouping is relative to the US government fiscal year (Oct–Sep), so fiscal month 1 is October, not January. Filter by award type, agency, recipient, keyword, NAICS code, Assistance Listing, PSC, or DEF code to trace spending trends in a specific area; award types default to contracts. Returns per-period totals and optional breakdowns by award category (contracts, grants, direct payments, IDVs, loans, other).

filters.description: Filters to scope the time-series aggregation. Defaults to contract awards when omitted.

agency_name.description: Awarding agency name filter, top-tier only (e.g., "Department of Defense") — the toptier_name from usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=awarding_agency; a sub-agency name matches nothing

assistance_listings.description: Filter by Assistance Listing (CFDA) program numbers, e.g. ["15.507"]: two digits, a dot, then three digits or capital letters (11.67A). Matches an award when any of its listings equals one of these exactly; several values match any of them. A matching award's primary listing can differ from the one requested, and amounts cover the whole award, not that listing's share. Only assistance awards (grants, direct payments, loans, other assistance) carry listings, so a call whose award types are all contracts or IDVs — including a contract default — is rejected as assistance_listings_type_mismatch. Use usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=cfda to look up numbers.

award_type_codes.description: Award type code filters (A/B/C/D, 02–05, etc.); groups may be mixed. When omitted, defaults to contracts (A, B, C, D).

def_codes.description: Filter by Disaster Emergency Fund Codes (DEF), e.g. ["Z"], or ["L", "M", "N", "O", "P"] for COVID-19: 1–3 letters or digits, sent uppercased — the codes usaspending_disaster_spending takes and usaspending_get_agency lists. Matches awards of any type funded under any of these codes. Amounts cover the whole matching award, not the share funded by the code, and DEF-filtered totals can be negative. An unknown code is rejected with the list of codes USAspending accepts.

items.description: Disaster Emergency Fund Code, e.g. Z or L

psc_codes.description: Filter by Product and Service Codes (PSC), e.g. ["Y1NE"]: 1–4 letters or digits, sent uppercased. A shorter code covers every code under it ("Y1" covers "Y1NE"); several values match any of them. Only contracts and IDVs carry a PSC, so a call whose award types are all assistance types is rejected as psc_codes_type_mismatch, and pairing psc_codes with assistance_listings matches nothing, since no award carries both. Use usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=psc to look up codes.

items.description: Product and Service Code or prefix, e.g. Y1NE or Y1

anyOf.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; month and day may be unpadded

time_period_end.description: End of the time window (YYYY-MM-DD). Given alone, the window starts at 2007-10-01, the earliest searchable date.

anyOf.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; month and day may be unpadded

time_period_start.description: Start of the time window (YYYY-MM-DD), 2007-10-01 or later. Given alone, the window runs through today (UTC).

group.description: Time grouping: fiscal_year (annual US govt FY: Oct–Sep), quarter (fiscal quarter), or month (fiscal month — an ordinal within the fiscal year, where 1 = October)

subawards.description: Aggregate subaward data instead of prime award data

name: usaspending_spending_over_time

applied_time_period_end.description: End of the time window sent (YYYY-MM-DD), including a filled-in end

applied_time_period_start.description: Start of the time window sent (YYYY-MM-DD), including a filled-in start

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_unavailable`: USAspending.gov API is unreachable or returns an error. `api_timeout`: USAspending.gov did not respond before the request deadline elapsed. `date_range_inverted`: Both filters.time_period_start and filters.time_period_end were supplied and the start falls after the end. `date_before_earliest`: The resolved start date precedes the 2007-10-01 earliest date this endpoint can search. `assistance_listings_type_mismatch`: filters.assistance_listings was given while every code in filters.award_type_codes is a contract or IDV code, or award_type_codes was left at its contract default. `psc_codes_type_mismatch`: filters.psc_codes was given while every code in filters.award_type_codes is an assistance code. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Names a time-window bound that was filled in because only the other was supplied, and — when no periods are returned — names any Assistance Listing, PSC, or DEF codes sent and suggests broadening filters. Absent when neither applies.

items.description: Time period row with total obligations and optional award-type breakdowns

aggregated_amount.description: Total obligation amount in USD for this period

contracts.description: Contract obligation amount in USD for this period

direct_payments.description: Direct payment obligation amount in USD for this period

grants.description: Grant obligation amount in USD for this period

idvs.description: IDV (Indefinite Delivery Vehicle) obligation amount in USD for this period

loans.description: Loan obligation amount in USD for this period

other.description: Other financial assistance obligation amount in USD for this period

time_period.description: Time period for this row. Populated per the requested grouping: fiscal_year alone, fiscal_year + quarter, or fiscal_year + month.

month.description: Fiscal month: an ordinal within fiscal_year, 1–12, where 1 = October and 12 = September. Fiscal month 1 of FY2025 is October 2024 — not January.

time_group.description: Time grouping applied: fiscal_year, quarter, or month

title: Spending Over Time
